description: Newlines inside a full splat's brackets are ignored inside a heredoc interpolation
notes: The spec says newlines are ignored inside parentheses, brackets, braces and function call arguments, but doesn't say so for interpolation sequences. hashicorp/hcl ignores newlines inside interpolations: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go calls PushIncludeNewlines(false) before parsing the expression.
